title: 第1章 序 裂痕第2章 决斗吧
content_zh:
;;
……“其实一直以来你都忍得很辛苦吧？”
……“到现在不用再忍耐了哦，因为我是绝对不会让莉娅死掉的。”
……“来吧，吞噬我，然后，君临世界……”
……“啊，对了，关于你之前跟我说的话，我的回应是……我也爱你哦，莉娅。”
......
赤色的君王在她的王座之上惊醒。
胸膛之下，那颗早已化为炽热熔炉的心脏剧烈搏动。
唇瓣上仿佛依旧残留着那抹带着铁锈味温热触感，数百年的光阴也未能磨灭那场噩梦的丝毫细节。
奥菲莉娅睁开眼睛，眼前熔岩般暗红的光泽在巨大的廊柱与穹顶间缓缓流淌，映照着她孤绝的身影。
她微微蜷缩起指尖，尖锐的指甲深深陷入王座扶手上不知名巨兽的头骨化石之中。
但这转瞬即逝的脆弱，如同投入烈焰的一片雪花，顷刻无踪。
当她站起身，赤足踏上冰冷的地面时，那丝属于“奥菲莉娅”
的软弱便被彻底封存。
每一步落下，都有无形的威压弥散开来，空气为之凝滞，火焰为之俯首。
当她推开那扇铭刻着古老龙语与战争史诗的巨门，天光倾泻而入的刹那，她已是那位君临大地，令万物战栗的赤色女皇。
门外侍立的纯血龙族护卫们感受到那股磅礴的气息，头颅垂得更低，不敢直视那仿佛由纯粹力量与威严构筑的身影。
奥菲莉娅没有看他们一眼，目光投向远空那片属于蓝龙之王，她妹妹艾莲娜的领地。
上一次相见……是几十年前了？再往前追溯，竟要以百年为单位。
时光对不朽的龙族而言，既是恩赐，也是折磨。

最近流传的消息带着不祥的意味。
艾莲娜，她那位痴迷于灵魂奥秘的妹妹，竟在数十年前亲手创造出了【不死族】这种亵渎生命循环的魔物。
她知道她在追寻什么，那个不切实际的幻梦，已经持续了数百年。
或许，是时候去将她从那份注定无望的执念中……唤醒了。
心念既定，奥菲莉娅周身红光一闪，化作一道撕裂长空的炽烈流火，瞬息间消失在云端，只留下空气中久久不散的灼热余波。
龙族大书库，知识的圣殿，亦是时光沉淀的坟墓。
奥菲莉娅找到艾莲娜时，她正置身于无数悬浮的巨大典籍与古老卷轴中央。
与奥菲莉娅那仿佛能点燃世界的炽烈不同，艾莲娜的美，是极寒冰渊般的静谧与剔透。
银白的长发如月下冰川流淌，冰蓝色的眼眸比最纯净的宝石还要深邃寒冷，肌肤白皙得近乎透明，仿佛由万年寒冰雕琢而成。
她只是静静站在那里翻阅着古老的羊皮卷，周身便自然弥漫着一股生人勿近的凛冽寒气，连空气都凝结出细碎的冰晶。
对于姐姐的到来，艾莲娜连眼睫都未曾颤动一下，仿佛奥菲莉娅只是一缕无关紧要的空气。
奥菲莉娅打破沉寂，声音在大书库空旷的回廊中显得格外清晰，也格外冰冷：“找到方法了吗？”
艾莲娜翻动书页的手指未曾停顿，冷淡的回应如同冰珠落玉盘：“没有。”
“既然几百年都毫无结果，那么，艾莲娜，放弃吧。”

..."Actually, you've been having a hard time enduring it, right?"
..."There is no need to be patient anymore, because I will never let Leah die."
..."Come, devour me, and then rule the world..."
..."Ah, by the way, regarding what you said to me before, my response is...I love you too, Leah."
...
The red king woke up on her throne.
Under his chest, the heart that had long since turned into a fiery furnace was beating violently.
The warm, rusty touch still seemed to remain on her lips, and hundreds of years had not been able to erase the slightest detail of that nightmare.
Ophelia opened her eyes, and in front of her eyes the dark red light like lava flowed slowly between the huge columns and dome, reflecting her lonely figure.
She curled her fingertips slightly, and her sharp nails dug deeply into the skull fossil of an unknown beast on the armrest of the throne.
But this fleeting fragility is like a snowflake thrown into the flames, disappearing instantly.
When she stood up and stepped onto the cold ground with her bare feet, the silk that belonged to "Ophelia"
The weakness was completely sealed.
With each step, invisible pressure spreads, the air becomes stagnant, and the flames bow to it.
When she pushed open the giant door engraved with ancient dragon language and war epics, and the skylight poured in, she was already the red queen who reigned over the earth and made all things tremble.
The pure-blood dragon guards standing outside the door felt the majestic aura and lowered their heads, not daring to look directly at the figure that seemed to be constructed of pure power and majesty.
Ophelia didn't look at them, and looked towards the territory in the distance that belonged to the King of Blue Dragons, her sister Elena.
The last time we met... was it decades ago? Looking back even further, it actually takes hundreds of years as a unit.
Time is both a gift and a torture to the immortal dragon clan.
The news circulating recently has an ominous undertone.
Elena, her sister who is obsessed with the mysteries of the soul, actually created the [Undead], monsters that blaspheme the cycle of life, decades ago.
She knew what she was pursuing, that unrealistic dream that had lasted for hundreds of years.
Perhaps, it was time to wake her up from that hopeless obsession...
With her mind set, Ophelia's whole body flashed with red light, turning into a blazing fire that tore through the sky, disappearing into the clouds in an instant, leaving only the long-lasting scorching aftermath in the air.
The Dragon Clan's great library is the temple of knowledge and the tomb where time has settled.
When Ophelia found Elena, she was in the center of countless suspended huge tomes and ancient scrolls.
Different from Ophelia's blazing fire that seems to set the world on fire, Elena's beauty is as quiet and transparent as the extremely cold ice abyss.
Her long silver hair flows like glaciers under the moon, her icy blue eyes are deeper and colder than the purest gemstones, and her skin is so white that it is almost transparent, as if it was carved from thousands of years of ice.
She just stood there quietly, flipping through the ancient parchment scrolls, and her whole body was naturally filled with a biting cold air that kept strangers away, and even the air condensed into fine ice crystals.
Regarding the arrival of her sister, Elena did not even tremble her eyelashes, as if Ophelia was just a wisp of insignificant air.
Ophelia broke the silence, and her voice sounded particularly clear and cold in the empty corridor of the big library: "Have you found a way?"
Elena's fingers never stopped turning the pages of the book, and her cold response was like an ice drop falling on a jade plate: "No."
"Since hundreds of years have yielded no results, then, Elena, give up."
